title: Extension Fee Charges on the Builder Extended Rate Lock Ledger
content:
Extensions written on a Builder Extended Rate Lock are priced by an extension fee charge on the lock ledger. Each charge stands on the ledger under its own printed charge number and records the extension days it prices.

## Rule

- The extension fee is fixed only after the lock record carries the extension it prices, its days counted in the extension days used beyond the extension days already charged on the lock ledger.
- The charge is booked on the lock ledger as an extension fee charge with its own charge number and the extension days it prices.

Restated on the records: the extension being priced is the part of the extension days used on the lock record that the extension fee charges already on the ledger do not yet carry. While the lock record shows no extension days beyond those already charged, there is no extension for the fee to price.

## Tool: `assess_extension_charge_644b0045`

**What it does.** One call books one extension fee charge for an extension on a Builder Extended Rate Lock: it writes the charge on the lock ledger with its own printed charge number and the extension days it prices, and adds the amount to the lock charges owed. The buyer sees the charge number and amount among the lock charges.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_extension_charge_644b0045` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lock_id` | The reference number of the Builder Extended Rate Lock the extension was written on, as returned by the rate lock finder | identifier as returned by the finder |
| `amount` | The extension fee charged | USD, a plain number rounded to 2 decimal places (half up, to the cent), no currency sign |
| `extension_days` | The calendar days of the extension this charge prices | an integer of 0 or more |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `status` "charge_booked", the `lock_id`, the `charge_reference` (the printed charge number, in the form LCK-CHG-4123), the `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), the `extension_days` (integer) and `charges_due` (USD, 2 decimal places, the lock charges owed including the charge). No other return or error is defined for the tool.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `amount` 515.43 and `extension_days` 15 books one extension fee charge of 515.43 carrying 15 extension days, returns its new charge number, and raises the lock charges owed by 515.43.
